offence_note: Large fraud on employer plus three later frauds

offence_note: Assault causing bodily harm, confinement, break and enter, threat

note: Reduced one month only for 20 days pre-trial custody credit at 1.5:1.

offence_note: Wilfully promoting hatred against Jewish people via website
